options.name: Soft card
options.summary: Calm and modern: the app sits on a white rounded card with a soft shadow, round checkboxes, quiet Delete buttons and a progress ring next to the title.

options.name: Bold header
options.summary: Energetic and colourful: a gradient header band holds the title, input and a progress bar; tasks sit below as roomy rows with square checkboxes.

options.name: Paper notebook
options.summary: Warm and minimal: no card, a serif title on an off-white page, lined rows like a notepad, an underline-style input and a single terracotta accent.
